description: This script manages automated device reboots based on maintenance windows, RFC processing status, and configuration parameters. It includes functions for timing, checking maintenance windows, RFC status, and orchestrates reboot procedures with various conditions and user abort options.

methods.name: calcRandTime
methods.description: Calculates a random time within a specified window for reboot scheduling.

methods.name: checkMaintenanceWindow
methods.description: Checks if the current time is within the device's maintenance window.

methods.name: checkrfcstatus
methods.description: Checks RFC processing status and waits until processing is complete or times out.
